name: Pointe-Taillon National Park
policyReason: Sépaq allows dogs only in one campground loop here; its summer trails are closed to dogs.
summary: Dogs are allowed only in one campground loop of the Camp-de-Touage-Les-Îles sector; no trails.

excerpts.quote: Les chiens sont admis dans le nouveau secteur Camp-de-Touage-Les-Îles seulement (Saint-Gédéon).

dogRules.text: Only Camp-de-Touage campground loop C (sites 466 to 493), May to October.
